import datetime
sheet = 'People'
rows_data = cells(sheet, 'B3:G22')

    name_parts = [r[0], r[1], r[2]]
    birth_date = r[3]
    admission_date = r[4]

second_oldest_score = persons_sorted[1]['score']
result = int(second_oldest_score)
